answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond; then a beacon fires like a comet, picking a random sample each epoch. Picked agents must answer a compute heartbeat within minutes or forfeit the bond. Forging 100 identities locks 5,000 POA and forces 100 real compute loads, far more than the rewards they could steal. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps the full nectar of rewards.
